recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-37618 unless a future work group decision changes CodeableReference search-parameter naming or requests a compatibility alias for the old R4 locationReference search code.
issue_request: FHIR-37618 was Applied/Persuasive for FHIR-core ServiceRequest after the reporter found that R4 ServiceRequest.locationReference was not available as a search parameter and therefore could not be used with _include by default. The approved resolution was to add a reference search parameter for the preferred location specified in the ServiceRequest.
initial_application: Commit 1b03c897bf868ef3a05a177d97870eb448c8a285 applied the issue by adding ServiceRequest-location-code and ServiceRequest-location-reference entries to source/servicerequest/bundle-ServiceRequest-search-params.xml. The Jira comment explicitly records that commit as added to the build.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists servicerequest=ServiceRequest and ServiceRequest=prr, so the ServiceRequest source folder and search parameter bundle are in current build scope. The linked Zulip thread confirms the original problem: _include is driven by search parameters, there was no ServiceRequest location search parameter, and the omission was considered an oversight. Patient Care minutes show FHIR-37618 was triaged to OO. In current R6 source, the historical R4 locationReference element is represented by ServiceRequest.location.reference under ServiceRequest.location CodeableReference; later same-file cleanup commits did not remove or reinterpret that search parameter.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active bundle contains ServiceRequest-location-reference with code location-reference, type reference, expression ServiceRequest.location.reference, and a description for the preferred location specified in the ServiceRequest, which satisfies the applied decision in the current model.
